title.ur: Islam ko sahi tareeqe se kaise samjhein?

intro.en: Carlos asks Ahmad questions about Islam. Ahmad answers politely and tells him to read books by fair writers. Notice the phrase «يُسْعِدُني ذلِك» – 'that makes me happy'.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein Carlos, Ahmad se Islam ke bare mein sawal poochta hai. Ahmad narmi se jawab deta hai aur kehta hai ke munsif musannifeen ki kitaben padho. «يُسْعِدُني ذلِك» yaani 'mujhe is se khushi hoti hai'.
intro.ar: يَسْأَلُ كارْلُس أَحْمَدَ أَسْئِلَةً عَنِ الإِسْلامِ، فَيُجيبُهُ أَحْمَدُ بِلُطْفٍ وَيَنْصَحُهُ بِقِراءَةِ كُتُبِ الكُتّابِ المُنْصِفينَ. لاحِظْ عِبارَةَ «يُسْعِدُني ذلِك».

dialogue.ar: أُريدُ أَنْ أَسْأَلَكَ عَنِ الإِسْلامِ. هَلْ يُضايِقُكَ ذلِكَ؟
dialogue.tr: urīdu an asʾalaka ʿani l-islām. hal yuḍāyiquka dhālik?
dialogue.en: I want to ask you about Islam. Does that bother you?
dialogue.ur: Main aap se Islam ke bare mein poochna chahta hoon. Kya yeh aap ko nagawar guzarega?

dialogue.ar: يُسْعِدُني ذلِكَ، وَأُرَحِّبُ بِأَسْئِلَتِكَ.
dialogue.tr: yusʿiduni dhālik, wa-uraḥḥibu bi-asʾilatik
dialogue.en: That makes me happy, and I welcome your questions.
dialogue.ur: Mujhe khushi hogi, aur main aap ke sawalon ka khair-maqdam karta hoon.

dialogue.ar: هَلْ كانَ نَبِيُّكُمْ مُحَمَّدٌ أُمِّيّاً؛ لا يَقْرَأُ وَلا يَكْتُبُ؟
dialogue.tr: hal kāna nabiyyukum Muḥammadun ummiyyan; lā yaqraʾu wa-lā yaktub?
dialogue.en: Was your Prophet Muhammad unlettered; he did not read or write?
dialogue.ur: Kya aap ke Nabi Muhammad ummi the; na parhte the na likhte the?

dialogue.ar: نَعَمْ، هذا صَحيح. كانَ نَبِيُّنا أُمِّيّاً.
dialogue.tr: naʿam, hādhā ṣaḥīḥ. kāna nabiyyunā ummiyyan
dialogue.en: Yes, this is correct. Our Prophet was unlettered.
dialogue.ur: Ji haan, yeh durust hai. Hamare Nabi ummi the.

dialogue.ar: إِذَنْ كَيْفَ أَتى بِهذِهِ الحَقائِقِ العِلْمِيَّةِ الَّتي لَمْ يَكُنِ النّاسُ يَعْرِفونَها في زَمَنِهِ، وَأَثْبَتَها العِلْمُ اليَوْمَ؟
dialogue.tr: idhan kayfa atā bi-hādhihi l-ḥaqāʾiqi l-ʿilmiyyah, allatī lam yakuni n-nāsu yaʿrifūnahā fī zamanih, wa-athbatahā l-ʿilmu l-yawm?
dialogue.en: Then how did he bring these scientific facts, which people did not know in his time, and which science proves today?
dialogue.ur: Phir woh in ilmi haqaiq ko kaise laye jo us zamane ke log nahin jante the, aur aaj ilm ne unhein sabit kar diya?

dialogue.ar: لَمْ يَأْتِ بِتِلْكَ الحَقائِقِ العِلْمِيَّةِ مِنْ عِنْدِهِ، بَلْ هِيَ مِنْ عِنْدِ الله. وَهذا دَليلٌ عَلى أَنَّهُ رَسول.
dialogue.tr: lam yaʾti bi-tilka l-ḥaqāʾiqi l-ʿilmiyyati min ʿindih, bal hiya min ʿindi llāh. wa-hādhā dalīlun ʿalā annahu rasūl
dialogue.en: He did not bring those facts from himself; they are from Allah. And this is proof that he is a messenger.
dialogue.ur: Woh in haqaiq ko apni taraf se nahin laye, balke yeh Allah ki taraf se hain. Aur yeh is baat ki daleel hai ke woh Rasool hain.

dialogue.ar: سُؤالٌ آخَر: هَلِ الإِسْلامُ دينُ العَرَبِ وَحْدَهُمْ؟
dialogue.tr: suʾālun ākhar: hali l-islāmu dīnu l-ʿarabi waḥdahum?
dialogue.en: Another question: is Islam the religion of the Arabs alone?
dialogue.ur: Ek aur sawal: kya Islam sirf Arabon ka deen hai?

dialogue.ar: الإِسْلامُ دينُ النّاسِ جَميعاً، في كُلِّ زَمانٍ وَمَكان. اُنْظُرْ إِلَى المُسْلِمينَ في كُلِّ العالَمِ، إِنَّهُمْ شُعوبٌ مُخْتَلِفَةٌ في لُغاتِهِمْ وَأَعْراقِهِمْ وَأَلْوانِهِمْ.
dialogue.tr: al-islāmu dīnu n-nāsi jamīʿan, fī kulli zamānin wa-makān. unẓur ilā l-muslimīna fī kulli l-ʿālam, innahum shuʿūbun mukhtalifatun fī lughātihim wa-aʿrāqihim wa-alwānihim
dialogue.en: Islam is the religion of all people, in every time and place. Look at the Muslims all over the world: they are different peoples in their languages, races and colours.
dialogue.ur: Islam tamam logon ka deen hai, har zamane aur har jagah ke liye. Poori duniya ke Musalmanon ko dekhein: woh mukhtalif qaumein hain, zabanon, nasalon aur rangon mein.

dialogue.ar: أَنا لا أَفْهَمُ الإِسْلامَ فَهْماً صَحيحاً.
dialogue.tr: anā lā afhamu l-islāma fahman ṣaḥīḥan
dialogue.en: I do not understand Islam correctly.
dialogue.ur: Main Islam ko sahi tareeqe se nahin samajhta.

dialogue.ar: لأَنَّكَ تَعْتَمِدُ في مَعْلوماتِكَ وَآرائِكَ دائِماً عَلى كُتّابٍ مُعادينَ لِلإِسْلام. اِقْرَأْ لِكُتّابٍ مُسْلِمينَ أَوْ مُحايِدينَ يَقولونَ الحَقيقَة.
dialogue.tr: li-annaka taʿtamidu fī maʿlūmātika wa-ārāʾika dāʾiman ʿalā kuttābin muʿādīna lil-islām. iqraʾ li-kuttābin muslimīna aw muḥāyidīna yaqūlūna l-ḥaqīqah
dialogue.en: Because you always rely for your information and opinions on writers who are hostile to Islam. Read writers who are Muslim or neutral and who tell the truth.
dialogue.ur: Kyunke aap apni maloomat aur raaye ke liye hamesha Islam ke mukhalif musannifeen par bharosa karte hain. Musalman ya ghair-jaanibdaar musannifeen ko padhein jo sach kehte hain.

dialogue.ar: سَأَقْرَأُ لِهَؤُلاءِ الكُتّاب.
dialogue.tr: sa-aqraʾu li-hāʾulāʾi l-kuttāb
dialogue.en: I will read these writers.
dialogue.ur: Main in musannifeen ko padhunga.

dialogue.ar: إِذَنْ، سَتَعْرِفُ عَنِ الإِسْلامِ الشَّيْءَ الكَثير.
dialogue.tr: idhan, sataʿrifu ʿani l-islāmi sh-shayʾa l-kathīr
dialogue.en: Then you will learn a great deal about Islam.
dialogue.ur: Tab aap Islam ke bare mein bahut kuch jaan lenge.

q.ur: Carlos ne Ahmad se kya poocha ...

options_ar: أَنْ يُجيبَهُ عَنْ أَسْئِلَتِهِ حَوْلَ الإِسْلامِ

q.ar: ما مَعْنى وَصْفِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ بِأَنَّهُ «أُمِّيّ»؟

options: Yes, he did not read or write

q.en: Ahmad says Islam is the religion of ...
q.ur: Ahmad kehta hai Islam kis ka deen hai ...

intro.en: Arabic does not allow two sukuns (silent letters) together except when you stop. Fix it by dropping the first or giving it a vowel. Example: «يَقُولُ» becomes «لَمْ يَقُلْ».
intro.ur: Arabi mein do saakin harf ek saath nahin aate, sirf waqf (rukne) ke waqt. Isay pehla harf hazf karke ya harkat dekar theek karte hain. Misaal: «يَقُولُ» se «لَمْ يَقُلْ».
intro.ar: لا تَسْمَحُ العَرَبِيَّةُ بِالْتِقاءِ ساكِنَيْنِ إِلّا عِنْدَ الوَقْفِ. وَنُعالِجُ ذلِكَ بِحَذْفِ الأَوَّلِ أَوْ بِتَحْريكِهِ. مِثالٌ: «يَقُولُ» تُصْبِحُ «لَمْ يَقُلْ».

vocab.ur: woh chalata hai / rehnumai karta hai

q.en: In Arabic two sukuns can meet only ...
q.ur: Arabi mein do saakin sirf kab milte hain ...
q.ar: مَتى يَجوزُ التِقاءُ ساكِنَيْنِ في العَرَبِيَّةِ؟

options: at the start of a word
options_ar: لا يَجوزُ أَبَداً حَتّى في الوَقْفِ

q.en: How do we remove the meeting of two sukuns?
q.ur: Do saakin ke milne ko kaise door karte hain?

options: drop or vowel the first one

intro.en: Arabic letters are of two kinds. The weak letters are only three: ا و ي. All the other letters are sound. Example: the verb «قالَ» has a weak letter in the middle, «بابٌ» has only sound letters.
intro.ur: Arabi huroof ki do qismein hain. Mo'tall (kamzor) huroof sirf teen hain: ا و ي. Baqi sab huroof sahih hain. Misaal: «قالَ» ke beech mein harf-e-illat hai, jabke «بابٌ» mein sirf sahih huroof hain.
intro.ar: الحُروفُ العَرَبِيَّةُ نَوْعانِ: حُروفُ العِلَّةِ وَهِيَ ثَلاثَةٌ فَقَطْ (ا و ي)، وَالحُروفُ الصَّحيحَةُ وَهِيَ البَاقِيَةُ. في «قالَ» حَرْفُ عِلَّةٍ في الوَسَطِ، وَفي «بابٌ» حُروفٌ صَحيحَةٌ فَقَطْ.

q.en: How many weak letters are there?
Which letters are called sound letters?
q.ur: Sahih huroof kaun se kehlate hain?

options: all letters except ا و ي
options_ar: كُلُّ الحُروفِ ما عَدا ا و ي

q.en: Which word has a weak letter in it?

intro.en: Listen to the dialogue between Sara and Tariq on the audio and answer the questions. Then practise asking a classmate about Islam: Do you know Islam well? Have you memorised the Quran?
intro.ur: Audio mein Sara aur Tariq ka mukalma suniye aur sawalon ke jawab dijiye. Phir apne saathi se Islam ke bare mein poochein: Kya aap Islam ko achhi tarah jaante hain? Kya aapne Quran yaad kiya hai?
intro.ar: اِسْتَمِعْ إِلى الحِوارِ بَيْنَ سارَة وَطارِق وَأَجِبْ عَنِ الأَسْئِلَةِ. ثُمَّ تَدَرَّبْ مَعَ زَميلِكَ عَلى سُؤالٍ عَنِ الإِسْلامِ، مِثْلَ: هَلْ تَعْرِفُ الإِسْلامَ جَيِّداً؟ هَلْ حَفِظْتَ القُرْآنَ؟

intro.en: A reading passage: Islam is the religion of tawheed brought by all the messengers. The passage uses verses and a hadith. Read slowly, sentence by sentence.
intro.ur: Ek parhne ka matn: Islam tawheed ka deen hai jo tamam rasoolon ko diya gaya. Matn mein ayaat aur ek hadees hai. Aahista aahista, jumla ba jumla parhein.
intro.ar: نَصٌّ لِلقِراءَةِ: الإِسْلامُ دينُ التَّوْحيدِ الَّذي جاءَ بِهِ جَميعُ الرُّسُلِ. في النَّصِّ آياتٌ وَحَديثٌ. اِقْرَأْ ببُطْءٍ جُمْلَةً جُمْلَةً.

dialogue.ar: الإِسْلامُ دينُ التَّوْحيدِ (لا إِلهَ إِلّا اللهُ مُحَمَّدٌ رَسولُ اللهِ)، الَّذي بَعَثَ اللهُ بِهِ الرُّسُلَ جَميعاً، وَأَوَّلُهُمْ نوحٌ عَلَيْهِ السَّلام، وَآخِرُهُمْ مُحَمَّدٌ ﷺ.
dialogue.tr: al-islāmu dīnu t-tawḥīd, alladhī baʿatha llāhu bihi r-rusula jamīʿan, wa-awwaluhum Nūḥun ʿalayhi s-salām, wa-ākhiruhum Muḥammadun ṣallā llāhu ʿalayhi wa-sallam
dialogue.en: Islam is the religion of tawheed, with which Allah sent all the messengers; the first of them was Nuh, peace be upon him, and the last Muhammad ﷺ.
dialogue.ur: Islam tawheed ka deen hai, jis ke sath Allah ne tamam rasool bheje; un mein pehle Nuh alaihissalam aur aakhri Muhammad ﷺ hain.

dialogue.ar: قالَ تَعالى: ﴿إِنَّ الدّينَ عِنْدَ اللهِ الإِسْلامُ﴾.
dialogue.tr: qāla taʿālā: inna d-dīna ʿinda llāhi l-islām
dialogue.en: Allah the Most High said: Indeed, the religion with Allah is Islam.
dialogue.ur: Allah Taala ne farmaya: Beshak Allah ke nazdeek deen Islam hi hai.

dialogue.ar: وَالإِسْلامُ هُوَ الدّينُ الباقي الَّذي نَسَخَ جَميعَ الرِّسالاتِ قَبْلَهُ.
dialogue.tr: wal-islāmu huwa d-dīnu l-bāqī alladhī nasakha jamīʿa r-risālāti qablah
dialogue.en: Islam is the lasting religion which abrogated all the messages before it.
dialogue.ur: Islam baqi rehne wala deen hai jis ne us se pehle ki tamam shariaton ko mansookh kar diya.

dialogue.ar: وَهُوَ صالِحٌ لِكُلِّ زَمانٍ وَمَكان. وَهُوَ دينٌ عامٌّ لِجَميعِ البَشَر؛ لِذا فَقَدْ تَكَفَّلَ اللهُ تَعالى بِحِفْظِهِ.
dialogue.tr: wa-huwa ṣāliḥun li-kulli zamānin wa-makān. wa-huwa dīnun ʿāmmun li-jamīʿi l-bashar; li-dhā faqad takaffala llāhu taʿālā bi-ḥifẓih
dialogue.en: It is suitable for every time and place. It is a religion for all mankind; so Allah the Most High took charge of preserving it.
dialogue.ur: Yeh har zamane aur jagah ke liye munasib hai. Yeh tamam insanon ka deen hai; isi liye Allah Taala ne iski hifazat ka zimma liya.

dialogue.ar: وَالمُسْلِمُ لا يُؤْمِنُ بِمُحَمَّدٍ ﷺ وَحْدَهُ، وَإِنَّما يُؤْمِنُ كَذلِكَ بِجَميعِ الرُّسُلِ الَّذينَ سَبَقوهُ.
dialogue.tr: wal-muslimu lā yuʾminu bi-Muḥammadin ṣallā llāhu ʿalayhi wa-sallam waḥdah, wa-innamā yuʾminu kadhālika bi-jamīʿi r-rusuli lladhīna sabaqūh
dialogue.en: A Muslim does not believe in Muhammad ﷺ alone, but also in all the messengers who came before him.
dialogue.ur: Musalman sirf Muhammad ﷺ par iman nahin rakhta, balke un se pehle aane wale tamam rasoolon par bhi iman rakhta hai.

dialogue.ar: وَالإِسْلامُ يَدْعو إِلى رَفْعِ الظُّلْمِ عَنِ الأَفْرادِ وَالمُجْتَمَعاتِ؛ لِذا فَقَدِ انْقادَتْ إِلَيْهِ الشُّعوبُ رَغْبَةً لا رَهْبَةً، فَوَجَدَتْ فيهِ المُساواةَ بَيْنَ النّاسِ جَميعاً.
dialogue.tr: wal-islāmu yadʿū ilā rafʿi ẓ-ẓulmi ʿani l-afrādi wal-mujtamaʿāt; li-dhā faqadi nqādat ilayhi sh-shuʿūbu raghbatan lā rahbah, fa-wajadat fīhi l-musāwāta bayna n-nāsi jamīʿā
dialogue.en: Islam calls for removing injustice from individuals and societies; so peoples submitted to it out of desire, not fear, and found equality among all people in it.
dialogue.ur: Islam afrad aur muashron se zulm door karne ki dawat deta hai; isi liye qaumein shauq se is ki taraf aayin, dar se nahin, aur is mein tamam logon ke liye barabari payi.

dialogue.ar: قالَ الرَّسولُ ﷺ: (كُلُّكُمْ لِآدَمَ وَآدَمُ مِنْ تُراب. لا فَضْلَ لِعَرَبِيٍّ عَلى أَعْجَمِيٍّ، وَلا لِأَسْوَدَ عَلى أَحْمَرَ إِلّا بِالتَّقْوى).
dialogue.tr: qāla r-rasūlu ṣallā llāhu ʿalayhi wa-sallam: kulluku li-Ādam, wa-Ādamu min turāb. lā faḍla li-ʿarabiyyin ʿalā aʿjamiyy, wa-lā li-aswada ʿalā aḥmara illā bit-taqwā
dialogue.en: The Messenger ﷺ said: All of you are from Adam, and Adam is from dust. An Arab has no superiority over a non-Arab, nor a black over a red, except by taqwa.
dialogue.ur: Rasool ﷺ ne farmaya: Tum sab Adam se ho aur Adam mitti se hain. Kisi Arab ko ajmi par aur kisi kaale ko surkh par fazilat nahin, magar taqwa se.

q.en: Who was the first of the messengers, according to the text?
q.ur: Matn ke mutabiq pehle rasool kaun the?

q.en: Why did peoples accept Islam, according to the text?
q.ur: Matn ke mutabiq qaumon ne Islam kyun qubool kiya?
q.ar: لِماذا قَبِلَتِ الشُّعوبُ الإِسْلامَ حَسَبَ النَّصِّ؟

q.en: «لا فَضْلَ لِعَرَبِيٍّ عَلى أَعْجَمِيٍّ إِلّا بِالتَّقْوى» means ...
q.ar: ما مَعْنى «لا فَضْلَ لِعَرَبِيٍّ عَلى أَعْجَمِيٍّ إِلّا بِالتَّقْوى»؟

intro.en: A broken plural is a plural where the word's shape changes, like طِفْلٌ → أَطْفالٌ. It is used for people with reason and without, men or women. There is no fixed rule, so learn the patterns.
intro.ur: Jam'-e-taksir woh jama hai jis mein lafz ki shakl badal jaati hai, jaise طِفْلٌ se أَطْفالٌ. Yeh aaqil aur ghair-aaqil, mozakkar aur moannas dono ke liye aata hai. Iska koi pakka qaida nahin, wazan yaad karein.
intro.ar: جَمْعُ التَّكْسيرِ جَمْعٌ يَتَغَيَّرُ فيهِ شَكْلُ المُفْرَدِ، مِثْلَ طِفْلٌ ← أَطْفالٌ. يُسْتَعْمَلُ لِلعاقِلِ وَغَيْرِ العاقِلِ، لِلمُذَكَّرِ وَالمُؤَنَّثِ، وَلَيْسَ لَهُ قاعِدَةٌ ثابِتَةٌ فَاحْفَظْ أَوْزانَهُ.

title.ur: Carlos ne Islam kyun qubool kiya?

intro.en: Smith and David see Carlos coming out of the mosque. Carlos tells them he became Muslim, and gives reasons: scientific facts in the Quran and the Islamic values of truth, trust, justice and equality.
intro.ur: Smith aur David, Carlos ko masjid se nikalte dekhte hain. Carlos batata hai ke usne Islam qubool kar liya aur wajuhat batata hai: Quran ke ilmi haqaiq aur Islam ki aqdar: sach, amanat, insaf aur barabari.
intro.ar: يَرى سْميث وَدايْفِد كارْلُس يَخْرُجُ مِنَ المَسْجِدِ، فَيُخْبِرُهُما أَنَّهُ أَسْلَمَ، وَيَذْكُرُ أَسْبابَهُ: حَقائِقُ عِلْمِيَّةٌ في القُرْآنِ وَقِيَمُ الإِسْلامِ كَالصِّدْقِ وَالأَمانَةِ وَالعَدْلِ وَالمُساواةِ.

dialogue.ar: رَأَيْتُ اليَوْمَ كارْلُس يَدْخُلُ المَسْجِدَ. ماذا حَدَثَ؟!
dialogue.tr: raʾaytu l-yawma Kārlus yadkhulu l-masjid. mādhā ḥadath?
dialogue.en: I saw Carlos today entering the mosque. What happened?!
dialogue.ur: Maine aaj Carlos ko masjid mein dakhil hote dekha. Kya hua?!

dialogue.ar: لَقَدْ أَسْلَمَ كارْلُس، وَهُوَ يُصَلّي في هذا المَسْجِدِ بِانْتِظام.
dialogue.tr: laqad aslama Kārlus, wa-huwa yuṣallī fī hādhā l-masjidi bi-intiẓām
dialogue.en: Carlos has become Muslim, and he prays in this mosque regularly.
dialogue.ur: Carlos Musalman ho gaya hai, aur woh is masjid mein baqaidgi se namaz parhta hai.

dialogue.ar: هَلْ أَسْلَمْتَ حَقّاً يا كارْلُس؟
dialogue.tr: hal aslamta ḥaqqan yā Kārlus?
dialogue.en: Did you really become Muslim, Carlos?
dialogue.ur: Kya tum ne waqai Islam qubool kar liya, Carlos?

dialogue.ar: نَعَمْ، أَسْلَمْتُ، وَالحَمْدُ لله.
dialogue.tr: naʿam, aslamtu, wal-ḥamdu lillāh
dialogue.en: Yes, I became Muslim, praise be to Allah.
dialogue.ur: Ji haan, main Musalman ho gaya, Alhamdulillah.

dialogue.ar: ما الَّذي جَعَلَكَ تُسْلِم؟!
dialogue.tr: mā lladhī jaʿalaka tuslim?
dialogue.en: What made you become Muslim?
dialogue.ur: Tumhein kis cheez ne Musalman kiya?

dialogue.ar: أَشْياءُ كَثيرَةٌ، مِنْها: وَصْفُ القُرْآنِ الجَنينَ في بَطْنِ أُمِّهِ. أَنا طَبيبٌ، وَأَعْرِفُ هذا الأَمْرَ. جاءَ القُرْآنُ بِهذا الوَصْفِ قَبْلَ أَكْثَرَ مِنْ أَلْفٍ وَأَرْبَعِمِئَةِ سَنَةٍ، وَأَثْبَتَ العِلْمُ الحَديثُ هذِهِ الحَقيقَةَ.
dialogue.tr: ashyāʾu kathīrah, minhā: waṣfu l-Qurʾāni l-janīna fī baṭni ummih. anā ṭabīb, wa-aʿrifu hādhā l-amr. jāʾa l-Qurʾānu bi-hādhā l-waṣfi qabla akthara min alfin wa-arbaʿimiʾati sanah, wa-athbata l-ʿilmu l-ḥadīthu hādhihi l-ḥaqīqah
dialogue.en: Many things, among them: the Quran's description of the foetus in its mother's womb. I am a doctor and I know this matter. The Quran came with this description more than 1,400 years ago, and modern science proved this fact.
dialogue.ur: Bohat si cheezein, in mein se: Quran ka maa ke pet mein janeen ka bayan. Main doctor hoon aur is baat ko jaanta hoon. Quran 1400 saal se zyada pehle yeh bayan laya, aur jadeed ilm ne is haqeeqat ko sabit kiya.

dialogue.ar: وَهَلْ هُناكَ أَسْبابٌ أُخْرى جَعَلَتْكَ تُسْلِم؟
dialogue.tr: wa-hal hunāka asbābun ukhrā jaʿalatka tuslim?
dialogue.en: Are there other reasons that made you become Muslim?
dialogue.ur: Kya aur bhi wajuhat hain jin se tum Musalman hue?

dialogue.ar: نَعَمْ، فَالإِسْلامُ يَدْعو إِلى الصِّدْقِ وَالأَمانَةِ وَالعَدْلِ وَالمُساواةِ وَالسَّلامِ، وَعِبادَةِ رَبٍّ واحِد. لَقَدْ أَسْلَمْتُ بَعْدَ قِراءاتٍ عَديدَةٍ، وَدِراساتٍ عَميقَةٍ.
dialogue.tr: naʿam, fal-islāmu yadʿū ilā ṣ-ṣidqi wal-amānati wal-ʿadli wal-musāwāti was-salām, wa-ʿibādati rabbin wāḥid. laqad aslamtu baʿda qirāʾātin ʿadīdah, wa-dirāsātin ʿamīqah
dialogue.en: Yes, Islam calls to truthfulness, trust, justice, equality, peace and worship of one Lord. I became Muslim after many readings and deep studies.
dialogue.ur: Ji haan, Islam sach, amanat, adl, barabari, aman aur ek rab ki ibadat ki dawat deta hai. Main ne bohat si kitaben aur gehri tehqeeq ke baad Islam qubool kiya.

dialogue.ar: أَعِرْنا بَعْضَ الكُتُبِ وَالدِّراساتِ الَّتي قَرَأْتَها.
dialogue.tr: aʿirnā baʿḍa l-kutubi wad-dirāsāti llatī qaraʾtahā
dialogue.en: Lend us some of the books and studies that you read.
dialogue.ur: Hamein kuch kitaben aur tehqeeqat udhaar dein jo aap ne parhi hain.

dialogue.ar: بِكُلِّ سُرور، فَلَدَيَّ كُتُبٌ كَثيرَةٌ عَنِ الإِسْلام.
dialogue.tr: bi-kulli surūr, fa-ladayya kutubun kathīratun ʿani l-islām
dialogue.en: With pleasure; I have many books about Islam.
dialogue.ur: Khushi se, mere paas Islam ke bare mein bohat si kitaben hain.

dialogue.ar: تَفَضَّلا مَعي إِلى البَيْتِ؛ لِنَتَناوَلَ بَعْضَ القَهْوَةِ، وَنَتَحَدَّثَ عَنِ الإِسْلام، وَأُعْطيكُما الكُتُب.
dialogue.tr: tafaḍḍalā maʿī ilā l-bayt; li-natanāwala baʿḍa l-qahwah, wa-natahaddatha ʿani l-islām, wa-uʿṭīkumā l-kutub
dialogue.en: Come with me to the house; let us have some coffee, talk about Islam, and I will give you the books.
dialogue.ur: Mere sath ghar chalein; thori coffee piyenge, Islam ke bare mein baat karenge aur main aap ko kitaben dunga.

dialogue.ar: هَيّا بِنا.
dialogue.tr: hayyā binā
dialogue.en: Let's go.
dialogue.ur: Chalein.

q.en: What does the Quran describe, which Carlos knows as a doctor?
q.ur: Quran kya bayan karta hai jo Carlos doctor hone ki wajah se jaanta hai?
q.ar: ماذا يَصِفُ القُرْآنُ مِمّا يَعْرِفُهُ كارْلُس لِأَنَّهُ طَبيبٌ؟

options: the foetus in the mother's womb

q.ur: «أَسْلَمْتُ» ke sath Carlos kya kehta hai?

title.en: Case endings of the sound feminine plural

intro.en: The sound feminine plural ends in ـات. Rule: it takes damma when it is the subject, and kasra for both accusative and genitive. Example: الطّالِباتُ ناجِحاتٌ (damma), فَحَصَتِ الطَّبيبَةُ المَريضاتِ (kasra).
intro.ur: Jam'-e-mo'annas saalim ـات par khatam hota hai. Qaida: marfu' ho to zamma, aur mansub aur majroor dono mein kasra. Misaal: الطّالِباتُ ناجِحاتٌ (zamma), فَحَصَتِ الطَّبيبَةُ المَريضاتِ (kasra).
intro.ar: جَمْعُ المُؤَنَّثِ السّالِمُ يَنْتَهي بِـ ـات. يُرْفَعُ بِالضَّمَّةِ، وَيُنْصَبُ وَيُجَرُّ بِالكَسْرَةِ. مِثالٌ: الطّالِباتُ ناجِحاتٌ (ضَمَّةٌ)، فَحَصَتِ الطَّبيبَةُ المَريضاتِ (كَسْرَةٌ).

q.en: The sound feminine plural in the nominative takes ...
q.ar: جَمْعُ المُؤَنَّثِ السّالِمُ في حالَةِ الرَّفْعِ عَلامَتُهُ...

q.en: In «فَحَصَتِ الطَّبيبَةُ المَريضاتِ» the word «المَريضاتِ» ends with ...
q.ar: في «فَحَصَتِ الطَّبيبَةُ المَريضاتِ» عَلامَةُ نَصْبِ «المَريضاتِ» هِيَ...

q.en: Which word is a sound feminine plural?
q.ur: Kaun sa lafz jam'-e-mo'annas saalim hai?

intro.en: Listen to the text and choose the right answer. Then practise speaking: invite someone to Islam, ask for a book, and talk about the future of Islam. Use polite phrases like «أُريدُ أَنْ…».
intro.ur: Matn suniye aur sahi jawab chuniye. Phir bolne ki mashq: kisi ko Islam ki dawat dena, kitab maangna aur Islam ke mustaqbil par baat karna. «أُريدُ أَنْ…» jaise jumle istemal karein.
intro.ar: اِسْتَمِعْ إِلى النَّصِّ وَاخْتَرِ الإِجابَةَ الصَّحيحَةَ. ثُمَّ تَدَرَّبْ عَلى الكَلامِ: ادْعُ شَخْصاً إِلى الإِسْلامِ، وَاطْلُبْ كِتاباً، وَتَحَدَّثْ عَنْ مُسْتَقْبَلِ الإِسْلامِ. اِسْتَعْمِلْ عِباراتٍ مُهَذَّبَةً مِثْلَ «أُريدُ أَنْ…».

options: I invite a person to Islam
I sell a person a book
options_ar: أَطْلُبُ مِنْهُ أَنْ يَعْرِفَ الإِسْلامَ وَيَدْخُلَ فيهِ

intro.en: A reading passage about the five pillars: the two testimonies, prayer, zakah, fasting and Hajj. Notice the hadith that begins «بُنِيَ الإِسْلامُ عَلى خَمْس».
intro.ur: Islam ke paanch arkan ka matn: shahadatain, namaz, zakat, roza aur hajj. Woh hadees dekhein jo «بُنِيَ الإِسْلامُ عَلى خَمْس» se shuru hoti hai.
intro.ar: نَصٌّ لِلقِراءَةِ عَنْ أَرْكانِ الإِسْلامِ الخَمْسَةِ: الشَّهادَتانِ وَالصَّلاةُ وَالزَّكاةُ وَالصَّوْمُ وَالحَجُّ. لاحِظِ الحَديثَ الَّذي يَبْدَأُ بِـ «بُنِيَ الإِسْلامُ عَلى خَمْس».

dialogue.ar: قالَ الرَّسولُ ﷺ: (بُنِيَ الإِسْلامُ عَلى خَمْس: شَهادَةِ أَنْ لا إِلهَ إِلّا اللهُ، وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّداً رَسولُ اللهِ، وَإِقامِ الصَّلاةِ، وَإيتاءِ الزَّكاةِ، وَحَجِّ البَيْتِ، وَصَوْمِ رَمَضان).
dialogue.tr: qāla r-rasūlu ṣallā llāhu ʿalayhi wa-sallam: buniya l-islāmu ʿalā khams: shahādati an lā ilāha illā llāh, wa-anna Muḥammadan rasūlu llāh, wa-iqāmi ṣ-ṣalāh, wa-ītāʾi z-zakāh, wa-ḥajji l-bayt, wa-ṣawmi Ramaḍān
dialogue.en: The Messenger ﷺ said: Islam is built on five: testifying that there is no god but Allah and that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah, establishing prayer, giving zakah, Hajj to the House, and fasting Ramadan.
dialogue.ur: Rasool ﷺ ne farmaya: Islam ki bunyad paanch cheezon par hai: gawahi dena ke Allah ke siwa koi ilah nahin aur Muhammad Allah ke rasool hain, namaz qayam karna, zakat dena, baitullah ka hajj aur Ramadan ke roze.

dialogue.ar: الرُّكْنُ الأَوَّلُ: الشَّهادَتانِ (لا إِلهَ إِلّا اللهُ مُحَمَّدٌ رَسولُ اللهِ). وَهُما مِفْتاحُ الدُّخولِ إِلَى الإِسْلام، فَمَنْ قالَهُما، فَقَدْ دَخَلَ في الإِسْلام.
dialogue.tr: ar-rukn al-awwal: ash-shahādatān. wa-humā miftāḥu d-dukhūli ilā l-islām, faman qālahumā faqad dakhala fī l-islām
dialogue.en: The first pillar: the two testimonies. They are the key to entering Islam; whoever says them has entered Islam.
dialogue.ur: Pehla rukn: shahadatain. Yeh Islam mein dakhil hone ki kunji hain; jis ne inhein kaha woh Islam mein dakhil ho gaya.

dialogue.ar: الرُّكْنُ الثّاني: الصَّلاةُ، وَهِيَ عَمودُ الدّين. وَهِيَ أَوَّلُ ما يُحاسَبُ عَلَيْهِ العَبْدُ يَوْمَ القِيامَة.
dialogue.tr: ar-rukn ath-thānī: aṣ-ṣalāh, wa-hiya ʿamūdu d-dīn. wa-hiya awwalu mā yuḥāsabu ʿalayhi l-ʿabdu yawma l-qiyāmah
dialogue.en: The second pillar: prayer, the pillar of the religion. It is the first thing a servant is held to account for on the Day of Resurrection.
dialogue.ur: Doosra rukn: namaz, jo deen ka sutoon hai. Qayamat ke din bande se sab se pehle isi ka hisab liya jayega.

dialogue.ar: وَالصَّلَواتُ خَمْسٌ: صَلاةُ الفَجْرِ وَالظُّهْرِ وَالعَصْرِ وَالمَغْرِبِ وَالعِشاء. وَلِلصَّلاةِ أَوْقاتٌ مُعَيَّنَة.
dialogue.tr: waṣ-ṣalawātu khams: ṣalātu l-fajri waẓ-ẓuhri wal-ʿaṣri wal-maghribi wal-ʿishāʾ. wa-liṣ-ṣalāti awqātun muʿayyanah
dialogue.en: The prayers are five: Fajr, Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib and Isha. Prayer has set times.
dialogue.ur: Namazein paanch hain: Fajr, Zuhr, Asr, Maghrib aur Isha. Namaz ke muqarrar auqat hain.

dialogue.ar: الرُّكْنُ الثّالِثُ: الزَّكاةُ، وَهِيَ ما يُخْرِجُهُ المُسْلِمُ مِنَ المالِ إِلَى الفُقَراء.
dialogue.tr: ar-rukn ath-thālith: az-zakāh, wa-hiya mā yukhrijuhu l-muslimu mina l-māli ilā l-fuqarāʾ
dialogue.en: The third pillar: zakah, which is what a Muslim takes out of his wealth for the poor.
dialogue.ur: Teesra rukn: zakat, yaani jo Musalman apne maal mein se ghareebon ke liye nikalta hai.

dialogue.ar: الرُّكْنُ الرّابِعُ: الصِّيامُ، وَهُوَ أَنْ يَتْرُكَ الإِنْسانُ شَهْوَتَيِ البَطْنِ وَالفَرْجِ، مِنَ الفَجْرِ إِلى غُروبِ الشَّمْس.
dialogue.tr: ar-rukn ar-rābiʿ: aṣ-ṣiyām, wa-huwa an yatruka l-insānu shahwatayi l-baṭni wal-farj, mina l-fajri ilā ghurūbi sh-shams
dialogue.en: The fourth pillar: fasting, which is that a person gives up the desires of the stomach and the private parts from dawn to sunset.
dialogue.ur: Chautha rukn: roza, yaani insan fajr se ghuroob-e-aftab tak pet aur sharmgah ki khwahishat chhor de.

dialogue.ar: الرُّكْنُ الخامِسُ: الحَجُّ، وَيَكونُ في مَكَّةَ لِأَداءِ المَناسِك. وَيَجِبُ الحَجُّ عَلَى المُسْلِمِ مَرَّةً واحِدَةً في العُمُر.
dialogue.tr: ar-rukn al-khāmis: al-ḥajj, wa-yakūnu fī Makkah li-adāʾi l-manāsik. wa-yajibu l-ḥajju ʿalā l-muslimi marratan wāḥidatan fī l-ʿumur
dialogue.en: The fifth pillar: Hajj, which takes place in Makkah to perform the rites. Hajj is required of a Muslim once in a lifetime.
dialogue.ur: Paanchwan rukn: hajj, jo Makkah mein manasik ada karne ke liye hota hai. Musalman par zindagi mein ek baar hajj farz hai.

q.en: How many pillars does Islam have?
Which pillar is performed five times a day?
q.ur: Kaun sa rukn din mein paanch martaba hota hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ رُكْنٍ يُؤَدّى خَمْسَ مَرّاتٍ في اليَوْمِ؟

q.en: Which pillar gives money to the poor?
q.ur: Kaun sa rukn ghareebon ko maal dena hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ رُكْنٍ فيهِ إِعْطاءُ المالِ لِلفُقَراءِ؟

title.en: The counted noun for numbers 3 to 10

intro.en: Numbers 3 to 10 go opposite to the gender of the counted noun. The counted noun is plural and in the genitive. Example: ثَلاثَةُ أَبْناءٍ (three sons, masculine) but ثَلاثُ بَناتٍ (three daughters, feminine).
intro.ur: 3 se 10 tak adaad, ma'dood ke mozakkar/moannas ke ulat aate hain. Ma'dood jama aur majroor hota hai. Misaal: ثَلاثَةُ أَبْناءٍ (teen bete, mozakkar) lekin ثَلاثُ بَناتٍ (teen betiyan, moannas).
intro.ar: الأَعْدادُ مِنْ ٣ إِلى ١٠ تُخالِفُ المَعْدودَ في التَّذْكيرِ وَالتَّأْنيثِ، وَالمَعْدودُ جَمْعٌ مَجْرورٌ. مِثالٌ: ثَلاثَةُ أَبْناءٍ (مُذَكَّرٌ) وَثَلاثُ بَناتٍ (مُؤَنَّثٌ).

q.en: Which is correct for three daughters?
q.ur: Teen betiyon ke liye kaun sa durust hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ عِبارَةٍ صَحيحَةٌ لِلدَّلالَةِ عَلى ثَلاثِ بَناتٍ؟

q.en: Which is correct for four books (كُتُب, masculine)?
q.ur: Chaar kitabon (كُتُب, mozakkar) ke liye kaun sa durust hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ عِبارَةٍ صَحيحَةٌ لِلدَّلالَةِ عَلى أَرْبَعَةِ كُتُبٍ (كُتُب مُذَكَّرٌ)؟

q.en: The counted noun after numbers 3-10 is ...
q.ar: المَعْدودُ بَعْدَ الأَعْدادِ مِنْ ٣ إِلى ١٠ يَكونُ...

q.en: How do you say «five rooms» (غُرَف, feminine)?
q.ar: أَيُّ عِبارَةٍ صَحيحَةٌ لِلدَّلالَةِ عَلى خَمْسِ غُرَفٍ (غُرَف مُؤَنَّثٌ)؟

intro.en: In this lesson you practise writing. Turn the first dialogue into a story, write a short essay called 'Islam', then retell the second dialogue and summarise 'The Five Pillars'.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein tehreer ki mashq hai. Pehle mukalme ko kahani ki shakl mein likhein, phir 'Islam' par mazmoon likhein, doosre mukalme ko dohrayein aur 'Arkan-e-Islam' ka khulasa likhein.
intro.ar: في هذا الدَّرْسِ تَتَدَرَّبُ عَلى الكِتابَةِ: حَوِّلِ الحِوارَ الأَوَّلَ إِلى قِصَّةٍ، وَاكْتُبْ مَوْضوعاً قَصيراً بِعُنْوانِ «الإِسْلام»، ثُمَّ أَعِدْ سَرْدَ الحِوارِ الثّاني وَلَخِّصْ «أَرْكانَ الإِسْلامِ الخَمْسَةَ».

dialogue.ar: أَرادَ كارْلُس أَنْ يَسْأَلَ أَحْمَدَ عَنِ الإِسْلامِ، فَرَحَّبَ أَحْمَدُ بِأَسْئِلَتِهِ.
dialogue.tr: arāda Kārlus an yasʾala Aḥmada ʿani l-islām, fa-raḥḥaba Aḥmadu bi-asʾilatih
dialogue.en: Carlos wanted to ask Ahmad about Islam, and Ahmad welcomed his questions.
dialogue.ur: Carlos ne Ahmad se Islam ke bare mein poochna chaha, aur Ahmad ne us ke sawalon ka khair-maqdam kiya.

dialogue.ar: رَأى سِميث كارْلُس يَدْخُلُ المَسْجِدَ، فَسَأَلَ ديفِد عَنْ سَبَبِ ذلِكَ، فَأَجابَهُ بِأَنَّ كارْلُس دَخَلَ في الإِسْلام.
dialogue.tr: raʾā Smith Kārlus yadkhulu l-masjid, fa-saʾala Dīfid ʿan sababi dhālik, fa-ajābahu bi-anna Kārlus dakhala fī l-islām
dialogue.en: Smith saw Carlos entering the mosque and asked David the reason; he answered that Carlos had entered Islam.
dialogue.ur: Smith ne Carlos ko masjid mein dakhil hote dekha to David se wajah poochi; usne jawab diya ke Carlos Islam mein dakhil ho gaya hai.

title.en: Calligraphy and spelling: nunation of the accusative

intro.en: First, practise the Ruq'ah script with a line of poetry. Then learn the rule: tanween on alif is written on the alif, except after a hamza on the line, or after ة. Example: عَزيزاً حَكيماً, but جُزْءاً and كَلِمَةً.
intro.ur: Pehle ruqah khat mein ek sher likhne ki mashq. Phir qaida: tanween-e-nasb alif par likha jata hai, magar jab us se pehle hamza alif ke upar ho ya aakhir mein ة ho. Misaal: عَزيزاً حَكيماً, lekin جُزْءاً aur كَلِمَةً.
intro.ar: تَدَرَّبْ أَوَّلاً عَلى خَطِّ الرُّقْعَةِ بِبَيْتِ شِعْرٍ. ثُمَّ تَعَلَّمِ القاعِدَةَ: يُكْتَبُ تَنْوينُ النَّصْبِ عَلى الأَلِفِ، إِلّا بَعْدَ هَمْزَةٍ عَلى السَّطْرِ أَوْ بَعْدَ التّاءِ المَرْبوطَةِ. مِثالٌ: عَزيزاً حَكيماً، لكِنْ جُزْءاً وَكَلِمَةً.

dialogue.ar: لِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ إِذا ما تَمَّ نُقْصانُ، فَلا يُغَرَّ بِطيبِ العَيْشِ إِنْسانُ.
dialogue.tr: li-kulli shayʾin idhā mā tamma nuqṣān, fa-lā yughharra biṭībi l-ʿayshi insān
dialogue.en: Everything, once complete, begins to decline; so let no one be fooled by the pleasantness of life.
dialogue.ur: Har cheez jab mukammal ho jaye to us mein kami aati hai; isliye koi insan zindagi ki khushgawari se dhoke mein na rahe.

q.en: Where is the tanween-nasb written in «عَزيزاً»?
q.ur: «عَزيزاً» mein tanween-e-nasb kahan likha jata hai?
q.ar: عَلى أَيِّ حَرْفٍ يُكْتَبُ تَنْوينُ النَّصْبِ في «عَزيزاً»؟

q.en: Which word has its tanween on the hamza, with no extra alif?
q.ur: Kis lafz mein tanween hamza par hai, alif ke baghair?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ يُكْتَبُ تَنْوينُها عَلى الهَمْزَةِ دونَ أَلِفٍ إِضافِيَّةٍ؟

q.en: How is the tanween written on «كَلِمَةً»?
q.ur: «كَلِمَةً» mein tanween kaise likha jata hai?

options: on the ta marbutah, no alif
